message:
feat(keepalive-multi r1): several PCs kept at once -- the bridge on the session table, the app per PC

native_bridge.cpp: the 0.2.30 globals (session, rendezvous socket, its error and chosen
candidate, observe / punch counts, connect gate) are each PC entry's own (SessionEntry);
SessionTable<SessionEntry> holds them with the one decoder. JNI: calls about a connection
take its handle (connect / observe / punch / close-if-own / park phase / counters /
status); calls that act on the picture, input, clipboard, targets, previews, settings and
macro playback take the binding the app got from nativeActivate -- a stale binding does
nothing. New: nativeReserve / Commit / Fail / Activate / End / EndAll / Epoch /
SetKeepalivePolicy / EntriesJson (reaps self-ended sessions; no token, no address).
Clipboard sync on/off is the user's: applied to every entry and each new one.
App: SessionPark is per PC (Kept, NativeEntry, onHostTap -> Reuse(handle) / Wait /
Connect / Discard(handle), listState, EntryOps = per-PC connect operation, ConnectIntents
owned by the lifecycle epoch). MainActivity keeps handle -> PC, activeHandle /
activeBinding; PC 목록 parks the PC on screen (BeginPark unbinds it first); a tap reuses a
kept PC, holds the latest tap while a park confirms, or connects a new PC beside the kept
ones (reservation + LRU in the native table; a failed connect ends only its entry);
연결 해제 ends that PC only; each card shows its own state / time left with its own 끊기,
the banner counts the kept PCs with 모두 끊기. Sign-out / refused session / exit end all
(new epoch); leaving the app ends the parked ones (the PC on screen as in 0.2.30); a
network change ends the kept ones; a PC missing from a list refresh ends nothing (the
0.2.30 host_gone ending is removed). The delayed unlock sequence keeps the binding it was
asked on.
gradle assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, unit 213/0 (SessionParkTest 16/0,
incl. negative controls: 0.2.30 single owner, r3 fallback). JNI signature check 73/73 (a
mutated copy fails it). Not yet run on a device.
